observations: Photo 0: an orange-painted gas cylinder with protective netting, carrying handle, and a dark logo (looks like a mountain/triangle mark) stenciled on the body; no legible brand name or kg stamp visible.
Photo 0: background shows an outdoor market setting, not a studio or gas depot.
Photo 1: close-up of the cylinder's top valve area, brass valve visible, handwritten 'MX' marking in black marker on the collar, no manufacturer plate, no weight/test-date stamp visible.
No regulator, hose, or gas content shown in either photo.
Cylinder body is glossy and unscratched, suggesting either new or freshly repainted, but no close-up of welds, base stamp, or valve threads to confirm origin or safety certification.

claims.evidence: No kg stamp, manufacturer plate, or country-of-origin marking visible in photo 0 or photo 1; the handwritten 'MX' mark and logo are not legible proof of origin or capacity.

risks.risk: Actual water capacity/kg rating may differ from the claimed 12kg.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the stamped capacity/tare weight on the cylinder collar or base.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic ~12-12.5kg cylinder without capacity premium

risks.risk: Claim of 'foreign' origin (often implying better steel/valve quality) is unverified.
risks.proof: Photo of country-of-origin stamp or manufacturer plate near the valve collar.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a standard/unbranded cylinder, not a premium foreign-brand one

risks.risk: Valve integrity and leak-tightness cannot be assessed from static photos.
risks.proof: Video of valve being opened/closed and a soap-bubble leak test.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not verified working, i.e., worst case needing valve service

risks.risk: No regulator or hose included, which affects usable price versus listings that bundle these.
risks.proof: Photo showing regulator/hose included in the sale.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cylinder only, no regulator

risks.risk: Possible recent repaint hiding dents, rust, or an expired safety test date.
risks.proof: Close-up of the base weld seam and any test-date stamp.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically refurbished, not certified safe

proof_requests: Clear photo of the stamped capacity (kg) and manufacturer/country marking on the cylinder collar.
Video of the valve opening/closing and a leak test with soap water.
Photo of the base weld and any safety test/inspection date stamp.
Confirmation photo of whether a regulator/hose is included.
response.reason: The item is clearly a used gas cylinder of roughly 12-12.5kg size, but the seller's 'foreign' and exact '12kg' claims are unverifiable from the photos, and no regulator, valve test, or origin stamp is shown, so it must be priced as a plain unbranded used cylinder without accessories at worst case.
